findings.function: supply, withdraw, borrow, repay, supplyCollateral, withdrawCollateral, liquidate, flashLoan (the SafeTransferLib reverts and require(cond, ErrorsLib.X) with a string constant): 31 loops
findings.decompiled: _4 = mem[64] / mem[64] = mem[64] + 64 / mem[_4] = 17 / mem[_4 + 32] = 0x7472616e73666572207265766572746564... / if not ext_call.success: ... _6 = mem[_4] / idx = 0 / while idx < _6: mem[idx + mem[64] + 68] = mem[_4 + idx + 32] ... / revert with Error(string reason), 32, mem[mem[64] + 36 len _6 + 32], ...
findings.source: SafeTransferLib.safeTransfer: require(success, ErrorsLib.TRANSFER_REVERTED) ('transfer reverted'), and the other ErrorsLib string constants
findings.issue: Each constant revert message is allocated at the free pointer and copied into the Error(string) buffer by a loop; the length read back (mem[_4]) is the constant 17 stored two lines above, and mem[64] is _4 + 64 just after its update, so the loop runs at most once over known data and the revert is simply 'transfer reverted'.
findings.rule: Same as c00050's first finding: fold mem[64] to b + k after 'b = mem[64]; mem[64] = mem[64] + k' and treat b + c ranges as disjoint for distinct small c (offsets are below 2^64); then the length and data words are constants and the buffer is 'revert with <string>'.
